caption: Palazzo Comunale, Cortona
composition: Clock tower and loggia on Piazza della Repubblica · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The palazzo is seen up a narrow cobbled street, its stone front filling the center of the frame. A broad ceremonial staircase climbs to the triple-arched loggia, and the clock tower rises directly behind it. Tall stone houses with shuttered windows flank the street on the left and right, hemming in the view. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 07:51 Europe/Rome: clear morning sun warming the façade while the street stays in cool shadow.
